{{Quote|Did ''Minister Halkans'' agree to our ''demands''?''"<br />"''Yes, he agreed to ''join us'' for dinner!|Two members of the Krath, after Halkans' beheading|<ref name="darklords1" />}}
'''Halkans''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[minister]] and [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] smelter active in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. In [[3997 BBY]], a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]-using [[Sith cult/Legends|secret society]] known as the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] [[Political uprising of the Empress Teta system|overthrew]] the [[Tetan monarchy/Legends|Tetan Monarchy]], and took control of the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Halkans refused the Krath's demands, and was [[Death/Legends|beheaded]]. His disembodied head was later served on a platter during a celebratory dinner at the [[Iron Citadel/Legends|Iron Citadel]]. During the dinner, his head was stolen by a [[Cat/Legends|Krath kitten]].

==Biography==
Halkans was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[minister]] and [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] smelter who worked in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. In [[3997 BBY]], the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]], a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]-practicing [[Sith cult/Legends|secret society]], [[Political uprising of the Empress Teta system|overthrew]] the [[Tetan monarchy/Legends|Tetan Monarchy]].<ref name="darklords1" /> After Halkans refused the Krath's demands, he became the last of the old regime to be [[Death/Legends|executed]].<ref name="cswe">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Halkans was beheaded, and his severed head was served to the Krath on a silver platter during a celebratory dinner at the [[Iron Citadel/Legends|Iron Citadel]], the Krath headquarters. Halkan's head was quickly snatched away by a [[Cat/Legends|Krath kitten]], who had to defend its prize from another Krath kitten.<ref name="darklords1" />

==Personality and traits==
Halkans was loyal to the old Tetan leadership, and refused to bend to the will of the usurping Krath. However, his loyalty would be the cause of his death.<ref name="darklords1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Halkans' first and only appearance came in [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - Dark Lords of the Sith'']], a story arc of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Tales of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series, written by [[Tom Veitch]] and released over late [[1994]]-early [[1995]]. He only appeared in the arc's [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 1|first issue]], appearing only as a severed head. In this appearance, Halkans was illustrated by [[Chris Gossett]].<ref name="darklords1" />
